dedupe_keys.name: on street car parking sensor data

description: On-street Car Parking Sensor Data is a series of datasets listed in City of Melbourne Open Data Portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by data.melbourne.vic.gov.au. The City of Melbourne has installed in-ground parking bay sensors in most CBD parking bays. These sensors record when a vehicle arrives and when it departs. Each record also includes the parking restriction for the bay and whether the vehicle has overstayed that restriction. This is the data for the 2012 calendar year. Coverage: City of Melbourne. The portal lists 10 near-identical datasets in this series (one per month, area, counter or year), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under Transport. Its keywords are accessibility, parking, sensors, transport, travel. The portal shows 2019-11-19 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/legalcode). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-melbourne-vic-gov-au-portal.
